title: Youth as Spiritual Leaders
excerpt: In The Great Spiritual Migration , I speak of Christian faith as a youth movement, and the UCC of Massachusetts offer an example of youth leadership in the Lenten Devotional Mass. youth prepared. You’ll find it here.
